title: Ocean Song
summary: A flowing poem celebrating the ocean's voice. Vowel team words create natural rhythm that echoes the movement of waves and tides.

pages.text: The ocean sings to me each day.
pages.scene: Waves rolling onto a golden beach, foam catching light

pages.text: I hear its song in ways I know.
pages.scene: Listening figure on the shore, eyes closed, feeling the sound

pages.text: The rain will stream and play.
pages.scene: Rain beginning to fall on water, creating circular ripples

pages.text: Silver beams of light break through the clouds.
pages.scene: Sunlight piercing storm clouds, illuminating the water below
Ocean depths visible in layers of blue-green, mysterious

pages.text: The sea keeps secrets in its keep.
pages.scene: Deep ocean waters, ancient and unknowable

pages.text: When moonlight floats across the sea.
pages.scene: Night ocean shimmering with moonlight, silver path on dark water

pages.text: The ocean flows like a dream, so free.
pages.scene: Ocean at peace, vast and limitless, eternal

metadata.aesthetic_focus: Ocean as music and mystery, moonlight and sensory immersion
